mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "search" browses rental listings for a location (city/state), with automatic pagination. "listing" fetches full detail for specific listing/apartment-building URL(s) directly.

propertyType.title: Property type
propertyType.description: "search" mode -- "Houses for rent" covers single-family homes, townhomes, and condos for rent; "Apartments for rent" covers apartment complexes/buildings (each with multiple floor plans).

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: "search" mode -- one or more "STATE/City-Name" path segments exactly as Point2Homes uses in its own URLs (e.g. "TX/Dallas", "CA/Los-Angeles"). Some cities require a county segment, e.g. "NV/Clark-County/Henderson" -- copy the exact segment from a point2homes.com/US/Houses-For-Rent/... URL if a plain "STATE/City" 404s.

maxItemsPerLocation.title: Max items per location
maxItemsPerLocation.description: "search" mode -- maximum number of listings to return per location. Pagination (30 items/page) is followed automatically until this cap or the end of the result set.

fetchDetails.title: Enrich with full listing detail
fetchDetails.description: "search" mode -- when true (default), each search result is additionally fetched for full detail (description, bed/bath breakdown per floor plan, agent/broker name, photo gallery, geo-coordinates). When false, only the lightweight search-result card (name, price range, address, one image, URL) is returned, which is much faster/cheaper for large location lists.

listingUrls.title: Listing / apartment-building URLs
listingUrls.description: "listing" mode -- full point2homes.com URLs to fetch full detail for, e.g. https://www.point2homes.com/US/Home-For-Rent/TX/Dallas/5031-Clover-Haven-Street.html or https://www.point2homes.com/US/Apartment-Buildings/TX/Dallas/The-Brazos0.html

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many detail pages (search mode's enrichment, or listing mode's URLs) to fetch in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
